## Project governance checklist

- [ ] I read the relevant `PROJECT_HANDBOOK.md` and `PROJECT_GOVERNANCE.md` sections.
- [ ] Tests were added/updated where behavior changed, or I explained why they are not applicable.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, local databases, factory state, caches, or credentials.
- [ ] Architecture-sensitive changes include an ADR, if required.
- [ ] Database migrations were checked for destructive operations and have the required approval/rollback plan.
- [ ] Security/privacy/payment/production-sensitive changes have the required independent review and approvals.
- [ ] I did not weaken CI, tests, or safeguards merely to make this change pass.
